## Checklist

- [ ] My commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) with my real name and valid email.
- [ ] I read the [Contributing Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] New or existing tests cover these changes, or I explained why tests are not practical.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for command, configuration, model, output, or backend behavior changes.
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, customer data, private backend URLs, or raw hardware dumps.
